title_zh: 软件与云服务行业 KPI
sector_scope: Enterprise SaaS, Cloud Infrastructure, Cybersecurity & Application Software (SEC SIC 7371-7374, 7376-7379)

kpis.definition_and_formula: cRPO = contracted backlog recognized over next 12 months; track YoY/QoQ growth & cRPO/RPO ratio
red_flags: cRPO YoY decelerating faster than recognized revenue
RPO expansion driven purely by longer contract duration without cRPO growth

kpis.definition_and_formula: Calculated Billings = Revenue + QoQ change in Total Deferred Revenue (note invoicing duration shifts)
red_flags: Billings growth trailing revenue growth by >5pp
Pull-forward via multi-year upfront billing or duration changes

kpis.definition_and_formula: Ending ARR from prior-year cohort / Starting ARR (check seat expansion vs gross churn & down-sell)
kpis.where_to_look: MD&A Key Business Metrics & earnings call Q&A
red_flags: NRR step-down >= 300bps YoY or management stopping NRR disclosure
Gross churn rising while price hikes mask seat contraction

kpis.definition_and_formula: Rule of 40 = YoY Revenue Growth % + FCF Margin %; FCF ex-SBC = FCF - SBC; track SBC/Rev & net share dilution
kpis.where_to_look: Cash flow statement, SBC Note (R*.htm) & 8-K Non-GAAP bridge
red_flags: Rule of 40 < 40 on FCF ex-SBC basis while Non-GAAP margin looks high
SBC > 30% of FCF or diluted shares growing > 3% YoY

filing_focus: sec_redline_diff on MD&A Key Metrics & Critical Accounting Estimates

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Duration-inflated RPO or upfront billing masking slowing cRPO bookings
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: cRPO vs total RPO growth gap or billings vs revenue deceleration in R*.htm/8-K
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q cRPO YoY growth < current-Q revenue YoY growth

counter_evidence_angles.angle: Non-GAAP margin & Rule of 40 dependence on SBC dilution
counter_evidence_angles.evidence_anchor: earnings_quality_diagnostics SBC/FCF > 30% or GAAP-to-Non-GAAP uplift gap
counter_evidence_angles.next_quarter_trigger: Next-Q FCF ex-SBC margin compresses YoY or diluted share count rises > 2% YoY

unit_and_period_checks: cRPO (12m) vs total RPO vs ARR (annualized run-rate) kept strictly separate
Rule of 40 labeled explicitly as GAAP OPM, Non-GAAP OPM, FCF, or FCF ex-SBC basis
Invoicing duration / multi-year upfront billings normalized before YoY billings compare

reconciliation.note: keep SBC add-back explicit and track net buyback offset

limits: NRR/ARR definitions are non-standardized across issuers; quote issuer definition or mark unavailable
